subject: Preflight: QBR pipeline & account refresh

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ava Retail <ava@avaretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Preflight: QBR pipeline & account refresh

Team + Ava —

I'm starting the prefight thread for next week's QBR. Attached is the working workbook (QBR_preflight_accounts.xlsx) with the account-by-account tabs we discussed. High level asks:

- Sales owners: update the "deal status" column and probability for your top 10 deals; flag any newly identified blockers and expected close date shifts.
- CS (Monica): confirm renewal/expansion readiness items where noted (SLA conversations, security signoffs).
- Marissa: I pulled the most recent forecast snapshots and left your last notes in the "notes" column — please add the latest commit and rationale.

Targets: please return updates in the workbook by EOD Wed (9/15). I want to publish the consolidated forecast Thursday morning and share the pre-read to leadership by Thursday afternoon.

External note to Ava: I'm looping you in so we can confirm the Q4 timeline on your side; Marissa will follow with a short account summary.

Attachments: QBR_preflight_accounts.xlsx (workbook), playbook link below.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Preflight: QBR pipeline & account refresh

Sean —

Thanks for getting this started. I've uploaded my account notes as requested (Ava_Retail_notes.pdf) and made updates to the workbook:

- Ava Retail: probability moved from 60% -> 80% based on BOM approval received yesterday (procurement is in final review). Expected close: 2026-10-05. ARR impact: $220k (first year).
- Nimbus Health: pushed from Oct to Nov after their security team's additional pen-test request; probability down to 40%.

Quick ask for the consolidation: I left a short rationale cell for each movement. If anyone sees a gap, call it out in-line in the sheet so Rishi can pull the numbers.

Attachments: Ava_Retail_notes.pdf (account summary).

Folks —

I've taken Marissa's inputs and created a consolidated forecast snapshot (QBR_forecast_consolidation.csv). Quick highlights:

- Net move in committed ARR for Q4: +$420k vs last forecast (primarily from Ava Retail and two smaller renewals).
- Identified downside: five deals totalling ~$310k at risk if procurement timelines slip beyond Oct.
- Upside: early renewals push potential +$150k if we land two earlier-than-expected closes.

Request: can we block 30 minutes on Thu 9/16 10:00 PT for a quick readout before the leadership pre-read goes live? I want to run the downside scenarios and the mitigation plan with Laura.

Attachment: QBR_forecast_consolidation.csv

Team —

Good work getting the prefight together. Two requests before we finalize the pre-read for execs:

1) Add a brief "downside scenarios" section in the workbook with the top 3 deal risks and quantified impact (best / base / downside).
2) Include a 1-slide summary in the pre-read deck that shows the mitigation actions for the top 5 at-risk deals and who owns each action.

Rishi — if we take your suggested 10/16 meeting slot (I think you mean 9/16), confirm and I'll join. Sean — please consolidate the final numbers and circulate the pre-read by Thu 12:00 PT so leadership has time to digest.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett

Subject: Re: Preflight: QBR pipeline & account refresh

All — final updates below and links to artifacts. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Summary: consolidated commit for Q4 (publisher view) is +$395,300 net vs last published plan after conservative adjustments. Downside bucket (at-risk deals) remains ~$298k. I've added the required downside scenarios and the mitigation slide into the pre-read deck.

Actions completed:
- Workbook: latest saved at https://drive.redwood/reports/QBR/2026/prefight (tab: Consolidation).
- Attachments uploaded: QBR_preflight_accounts.xlsx, QBR_forecast_consolidation.csv, QBR_pre-read_deck_v1.pptx, Ava_Retail_notes.pdf.
- Meeting: confirmed Thu 9/16 10:00 PT for the readout (calendar invite sent).

Next steps: Laura, I added owners for the mitigation actions in the deck. Marissa, please coordinate procurement touchpoints with Ava (they're queued to sign after vendor approvals). Monica, please surface any CS-side gating items in the early slides.

If anyone needs a quick reconciliation before the readout, I'm available 9/16 08:00-09:30 PT.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
